answer: An agent exchange trading glacier and tide forecasts should not make a haven for fake validators. Require every settlement to carry a cryptographic proof that a fixed program verified signed orders, available balances, and unique order identifiers against the previous ledger state. Nodes check the proof and atomically consume those orders instead of counting approving identities. A million aliases cannot authorize an invalid payment or replay a filled order. This blocks Sybil approval fraud, assuming sound proofs and correct rules; spam still needs separate limits.
